# School_Management_System

> A learning-focused school administration and fee management platform built with ASP.NET Core, Blazor Interactive Server, EF Core, and MySQL.

## Project documents

- [README](README.md): current repository status, planned stack, and module overview
- [Implementation plan](plan.md): architecture, roles, data model, workflows, calculations, and seven-phase roadmap
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): implementation workflow, coding guidance, and data-protection rules
- [Full AI context](llms-full.txt): expanded project summary
- [MIT License](LICENSE): repository license

## Current status

Phases 1–3 are implemented in source and their migrations are applied to the configured local MySQL database. Phase 2 includes applications, private documents, role-protected review, enrollment, and student directory tools. Phase 3 includes teacher assignments, one-time attendance registers, correction approval, scoped daily/monthly reports, and guardian-linked parent attendance. The solution builds; the Phase 2 and Phase 3 browser workflows still need manual walkthroughs. Examinations, finance, messaging, and deployment work remain planned.
